div.div: قَحَّادٌ A solitary man, who has neither brother nor offspring: (IAar, Sh, O, K, TA:) and وَاحِدٌ ↓ قَاحِدٌ signifies [the same, or the like; i. q.] صُنْبُورٌ: (IAar, Sh, T, O:) [see also صَاخِدٌ:] accord. to the K, ↓ قَاحِدٌ in this case is an imitative sequent to وَاحِدٌ, and so accord. to the M: and it is said in the T that AA mentions this phrase, as on the authority of Abu-l-'Abbás, with ف, saying وَاحِدٌ فَاحِدٌ; but that it is correctly as mentioned [and expl.] by Sh, on the authority of IAar; i. e. that one says ↓ وَاحِدٌ قَاحِدٌ , and صَاخِدٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
